subject: Communication
title: Carl Rogers and Reflective Listening
description: Learn Carl Rogers and Reflective Listening in one minute.

hook.text: Carl Rogers transformed therapy with one radical idea: the most healing thing you can do for someone is simply listen.

buildup.text: Reflective listening: paraphrase the speaker's words and feelings back to them, showing that you've genuinely understood.

discovery.text: Rogers found that when people feel truly heard, they become calmer, more open, and more able to solve their own problems.

twist.text: Most people hate reflective listening at first — it feels artificial. But results make believers.

climax.text: The magic isn't in the technique. It's in the message it sends: 'You matter enough for me to work at understanding you.'

punchline.text: Sometimes the most powerful thing you can say is what someone just said — back.

quiz.question: What did Carl Rogers find happens when people feel truly heard?
options: They become calmer and more able to solve their own problems
